audit.proof_assessment: The supplied Grok receipt is not an oracle for these bytes. Its HIGH/MEDIUM items cite unioned globs (src/lib/operatingEnvironment/**, docs/audits/obx-p180/**, docs/plans/**/obx-p180/**, fixtures/obx-p180-*.json), allowedPaths containing docs/eval/one-box-program/manifest.json, informal gate labels (registry/route owners, Budget/Operations Owner), verifier SoD limited to policy/evaluator authors, and escalation omission that still counts as current. None of those strings exist in the added proposal. Current ticketScopes enumerate exact files, predecessorTicketIds, and kebab-case role IDs; effectPolicy is deny-every-unlisted-path-and-effect; forbiddenEffects include expose-ui-or-product-surface, edit-program-eval-manifest-or-unrelated-eval-lane, and quality-pass-or-provider-connected-evaluation-claim; verifier overlap with any reviewed-diff author is an invalidator; missing/non-human/same-human/expired escalation makes OwnerAssignmentV1 unavailable; status proposed-not-accepted with null acceptance fields and OWNER-MUST-SET/TO-BE-FILLED placeholders. Treat the receipt as a prior-gap checklist, not as unresolved findings.
residual_risks: Accepting by reshaping this record into the existing scoped-implementation-authorizations.json schema (allowedPathPrefixes / unioned allowedExactPaths / flat ticketIds) would drop per-ticket path, predecessor, and role binding.
T07 predecessorTicketIds lists only T06; T01–T05 are transitive, not explicit, and ‘code frozen’ is not a field on the ticket record.
T03 and T04 both predecessor T02 (DAG) while the ledger Order column implies a total order.
T05 allowedPaths can rewrite Step 5 evaluator/fixture bytes, not only obx-p180-offline-manifest-entry-v1.json.
Sentinel planPacketHash/expiresAt stay non-null; a sloppy accept that sets only acceptedBy would not be schema-invalid without extra checks.
No specified mapping from git authors to humanActorId, and no actor registry for escalation expiry outside OwnerAssignmentV1.
Proposed eval gate --allow-fs-read=. is wider than credential-read-or-issuance.
